title: Government Regulation of Chiropractors for Consumer Protection against Poor Standards and Malpractice
what_it_is: Government Regulation of Chiropractors for Consumer Protection against Poor Standards and Malpractice

sections.label: MOH chiropractic regulation risk approach
sections.summary: MOH considers chiropractic services not high risk, so they are self-regulated through professional associations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: When it comes to professional regulation, the Ministry of Health's (MOH's) main consideration is the potential risk to patients.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In determining the risk levels, we consider factors, such as nature and scale of practice, patient awareness and evidence of adverse outcomes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As of now, chiropractic services as a form of complementary and alternative treatment are not considered high risk.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Hence, our approach is self-regulated through their professional associations.

sections.label: Non-chiropractors misrepresenting as chiropractors
sections.summary: Since November 2020, the Chiropractic Association (Singapore) received at least 61 reports of non-chiropractors misrepresenting themselves as chiropractors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang West)
sentences.text: First, since November 2020, the Chiropractic Association (Singapore) has received reports of at least 61 cases of non-chiropractors misrepresenting themselves as chiropractors.

sections.label: Complaints against authentic chiropractors
sections.summary: Since 2015, the Chiropractic Association (Singapore) received 21 public complaints against authentic chiropractors, mostly about prepaid packages or sub-standard treatment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang West)
sentences.text: The context is that since 2015, the Chiropractic Association (Singapore) has received 21 complaints from members of the public against authentic chiropractors, mostly regarding prepaid packages or sub-standard quality treatment.

sections.label: MOH monitoring chiropractic self-regulation
sections.summary: MOH says overall harm risk remains low, but will monitor complaints and review stronger regulations if safeguards prove inadequate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Based on the evidence we have, the overall risk of harm from chiropractic services remains low.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: But I must remind everyone that self-regulation is not a free pass.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We will continue to monitor complaints and adverse outcomes, and if the evidence changes or if the existing safeguards prove inadequate, MOH will review whether stronger regulations are needed.
